messages:
deploy-bot: starting staged rollout for /v2 (schema-negotiation path)
- initial traffic: 3% (careful start)
- window: 2026-03-22 02:30-04:30 UTC
- auto-rollback: 5xx > 0.4% sustained 3m OR client-4xx surge > 1.2% vs baseline
- operators: @ops-rita, @release-eng will monitor

nate: quick note: this rollout includes a minor schema tweak for the metadata header (Content-Meta). We added case-insensitive fallback but some older clients may still fail. Recommend tenant pins for: gov-edge, railway-inc, acme-corp.

anika: added a section in release notes about migration header behaviour and sample client patch (lowercasing header). Link: https://redwood.infer/releases/v2-schema-20260322

sam: support-mig can you coordinate customer comms for pinned tenants? I can draft a short mitigation note.

support-mig: yes, will notify TAMs for gov-edge and railway-inc. acme-corp already on watchlist.

ops-rita: applying tenant pins now:
`/deploy pin api-v2 tenant=gov-edge until=2026-03-22T12:00Z`
`/deploy pin api-v2 tenant=railway-inc until=2026-03-22T12:00Z`
`/deploy pin api-v2 tenant=acme-corp until=2026-03-22T12:00Z`
Pins applied. Also pinning customer group mobile-legacy until midday as precaution.

deploy-bot: group pin applied: mobile-legacy -> pinned to v1 until 2026-03-22T12:00Z

qa-lin: smoke and regression tests running against canary. Will post any regression diffs. Running mobile sims and embedding flows.

deploy-bot: initial telemetry snapshot: p95 latency 125ms, errors 0.06%. No anomalies in anomaly-detector stream. Telemetry: https://telemetry.redwood/streams/v2-canary-schema

nate: reminder: if we see elevated client-4xx from a region, prefer reducing canary % (3 -> 1) before full rollback. That helps isolate.

anika: merged release notes and migration snippet to docs site. Also added a short curl example to normalize headers client-side.

sam: added runbook entry for staged rollback steps + operator checklist. Will paste commands here.

ops-rita: setting hold for automated progression; manual approval required to move to 10%.

qa-lin: one mobile sim failure: Android 8 client sends Content-Meta in mixed case and our fallback returns 422 for one flow. Filed bug #4622. Marked as medium.

support-mig: flagged to railway-inc TAM; they might opt to stay pinned until patch.

nate: ok keep railway-inc pinned. Ops-rita please extend railway-inc pin to 2026-03-23T00:00Z.

ops-rita: extending railway-inc pin:
`/deploy pin api-v2 tenant=railway-inc until=2026-03-23T00:00Z`
Extended. Canary still at 3% for unpinned traffic.

release-eng: monitoring dashboards. If telemetry stays flat for 15m and QA verifies no regressions in non-pinned sims, approve to 10%. Otherwise hold.

deploy-bot: auto-progress disabled; awaiting manual approval.

sam: sharing rollback helper snippet for runbook:
```
# immediate rollback to v1
curl -s -X POST https://deploy.redwood/api/ops/rollback -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP" -d '{"service":"api","target":"v1"}'
```

qa-lin: will re-run failing sim with header normalization patch; will update thread.

anika: created short migration FAQ for SDK owners; linking in release notes.

nate: good. once QA green for 15m, please ping me for approval.

support-mig: queued customer notice drafts for pinned tenants; holding send until we either progress or rollback.

ops-rita: watching metrics and alerts. Ping me if we need to scale down traffic or rollback.

release-eng: approved to proceed to 10% at 02:55 UTC (manual approval given). Proceeding if telemetry remains stable.

deploy-bot: advancing canary to 10% now. New telemetry endpoint: https://telemetry.redwood/streams/v2-canary-schema/10pct

qa-lin: re-tested mobile sim with patch; 422 gone. QA marks "accept" for non-pinned sims. No new regressions in 10m.

sam: cheers. leaving runbook note: "if customer reports 4xx after upgrade, check header-case fallback and suggest client-side normalization patch v1.2.3"

nate: final check: confirm all pinned tenants notified and release notes link shared.

support-mig: confirmed notifications queued and release notes link included.

ops-rita: all clear on ops side. Will keep pins until 2026-03-22T12:00Z except railway-inc extended to 2026-03-23.

pr: small doc tweak pending but not blocking.

release-eng: closing this coordination thread. If any rollback needed, reopen with `/deploy rollback api-v2` and tag @ops-rita.

deploy-bot: archived (deploy id: deploy-3490012345).
